title: Combining microfluidics with machine learning algorithms for RBC classification in rare hereditary hemolytic anemia.
summary: The pilot analyzed 79 videos from 32 participants and reported leave-one-video-out performance for healthy-versus-disease and subtype classification. Small pilot cohort and video-level evaluation limit patient-level generalization; external clinical validation is not established.
ai_technology: Pretrained AlexNet transferred image features from red-cell videos; cooperative classifiers combined features from a spleen-mimicking microfluidic assay to classify deformability patterns.
